name: IMG-099 Imperial Mark IV patrol droid
wookieepedia_title: IMG-099 Imperial Mark IV patrol droid
description: The IMG-099 Imperial Mark IV patrol droid, also known as Imperial Mark IV sentry droid, was a model of sentry droid developed by the Imperial Department of Military Research. They were used by the Galactic Empire for scouting missions during the Galactic Civil War. The low-flying droids were equipped with efficient sensors and could record holographic images.
